note: The descent of the legend: who took what from whom, and what they changed. Edges are inheritance relations attested by the texts themselves or by uncontested scholarly consensus; where the direction of borrowing is genuinely unresolved it is marked `contested` and drawn as such. Motif paths trace one object through the tradition.

edges.what: Wace and Layamon translate him into French and English
Welsh matter — direction of borrowing unresolved
Lancelot, the love, and the Grail — systematised
the unfinished Perceval, completed in the opposite direction
the sacred vessel, turned into a judge
the quest, translated closely and framed as a loss
the Tristan matter, absorbed into the Round Table
the Roman war, and the whole of the ending
nothing — the finest English poem left no mark on him
the entire narrative, reread as a civilisation in decline

path.change: Caledfwlch: a Welsh war-leader's weapon, no more
latinised to Caliburn, and forged in Avalon — the otherworld arms the crown
outranked: the Grail is prized above the sword
split in two — a stone that elects, and a lake that lends and takes back
invented by Wace in 1155 as engineering against precedence
becomes a kin-network, and therefore a fault line
given a written constitution, and then eighteen books of its breach
reread as the founding institution of a civilisation that rots

motifs.label: The Grail

path.change: a bleeding spear and a severed head — no vessel at all
a graal, carried in procession, deliberately never explained
the vessel of the Last Supper, with a genealogy back to the Crucifixion
a test with a pass mark: cleansed and purged, or nothing
refused entirely — a stone, healed by a question asked out of pity
kept sacred, and mourned: the vow that empties the hall
downgraded to a collective error

motifs.note: The first hop runs backwards on the axis, and that is deliberate. Peredur survives in manuscripts later than Chrétien's poem, but preserves a form of the scene with no vessel and no theology in it — which may mean it is older, or may mean it is a Welsh retelling. The direction has never been settled, so it is drawn as unresolved and placed where the material, not the parchment, suggests.

path.change: a coup: Mordred takes crown and queen while Arthur is abroad
invented as a virtue — love overrules reason, and ennobles
the control experiment: a potion removes the choice, and ruins them anyway
made mutual, fatal, and Grail-disqualifying
kept tragic and defended in the author's own voice
condemned, with the weight put on the queen
the king wounded deadly, and Britain falls with him
a maimed king whose cure is an unasked question
wounded for love, and healed by compassion
the Dolorous Stroke: one blow, three kingdoms, and no cure for eleven books
borne to Avalon for the healing of his wounds — asserting nothing
Wace records the Bretons' hope; Layamon names Argante
reported as what many men say, and pointedly not endorsed
the passing as apotheosis, with a new sun rising
Merlin invented, and prophecy made into a dynastic charter
the prophet given his own branch, and the doom built into the architecture
the seer destroyed by the one future he saw most clearly
Vivien corrupts him deliberately, and the tragedy becomes a seduction
